At Doane University, you build your unique journey

We take a personal approach to your education, helping you discover your passion so you can unlock your full potential. With our history of building leaders, you’ll graduate with more than a degree — you’ll also have the confidence and skills to make a difference in your career and community.

Undergraduate Majors and Minors

Discover your career path today. Immersed in the liberal arts, Doane offers undergraduate majors and minors that will start you on our journey to success. Once you’ve earned your undergraduate degree, continue your journey and set yourself for greater success by earning a graduate degree.

Graduate Programs -Master’s Degrees

A master's degree is an advanced academic degree that typically follows a bachelor's degree. By earning a master’s degree, you display a higher level of expertise and knowledge in a specific field of study. Earning a master's degree can enhance career opportunities and provide a deeper understanding of a chosen subject.

  • Counseling
  • Curriculum and Instruction
  • Educational Leadership
  • Initial Certification at the Advanced Level
  • Leadership
  • Business Administration
  • Business Administration – Daytime MBA for Recent Graduates
  • School Counseling
  • Social Emotional Learning Specialization

Post-Master's Degree

  • Education Specialist

Graduate Programs - Doctoral Degree

Doane University's Doctorate of Education (EdD) prepares students like you by developing the specialized knowledge and skills required of modern educational leaders. EdD graduates develop the capacity to make an impact in their professional and personal roles in the communities they serve. Graduates gain expertise, knowledge, skills and disposition to continuously engage in issues of policy, program and practice. This degree is for anyone seeking a degree as a capstone of their preparation to be an educational leader.

  • Doctorate of Education

Teaching Endorsements - Educator Certification

Earn a teaching endorsement to elevate your educator certification. Become an expert in subject matters that interest you. Now is the time to diversify your education and your teaching career.

  • Early Childhood Teaching Endorsement
  • English as a Second Language Teaching Endorsement
  • Reading and Writing Teaching Endorsement
  • Reading Specialist Teaching Endorsement
  • Special Education Teaching Endorsement
